scientific_question: Can the existing onset-detection process recover the complete controlled double-bass event population under a scientifically defensible configuration without additional detections or changed ordering?

ground_truth_asset.path: recordings/validation/ground_truth/03 THE COST OF LIVING versione intro + 8 bar.musicxml

sensitivity_justification: Delta is the normalized peak-above-local-average requirement and directly governs admission of weak local maxima. A factor-of-two set around the installed 0.07 default is scale-symmetric, fixed before execution, and does not use the known missing event. All temporal windows and post-filter parameters remain unchanged.

post_blind_mapping.temporal_origin: MusicXML score time zero = WAV sample zero
post_blind_mapping.correspondence: Unique edge in both directions within the fixed bound; no observation or symbolic onset may be reused.

success_rule: PASS only for 28 filtered PulseCandidates, 28 derived EME, deterministic replay, stable ordering, no excess or duplicate detection, and unique correspondence to all 28 authoritative events.
prohibited: Ground Truth access before blind freeze
